subject: general
question: A is 25 years younger than B. The age of B would be double the age of C after 15 years. The current age of B is three times the current age of C. What is the current age of A?
solution:
Given A is 25 years younger than B.

⇒ A = B - 25 ............. (i)

Age of B would be double the age of C after 15 years.

⇒ (B + 15) = 2(C + 15)

⇒ B + 15 = 2C + 30 ............ (ii)

The current age of B is three times the current age of C.

⇒ B = 3C ........... (iii)
